name: Aquitani
text: The Aquitani are a people of old Gaul. Their land lies in the south-west of what is now France. Their country runs from the river Garrone to the Pyrenean hills. The name survives in the province of the south-west of modern France.

attributes.attribute: people of the south-west of old Gaul
